trait.name: Kindled
trait.text: At the start of your turn, gain 1 Arcana and Sharpen your Obsidian Blade by 1.

blurb: A spellblade of black glass and ember. Spends Arcana on her biggest cards, calls an Obsidian Blade that every Sharpen improves for good, and fills her hand with Retainers and borrowed cards.
buildPaths: Blade: sharpen the Obsidian Blade and swing it
Arcana: gain it, then spend it on big cards
Court: create cards and play many
howTo: Arcana is a second resource that lasts the whole fight. You start every fight with 3 and gain 1 more each turn. Cards with an orange orb spend it; others gain it.
The Obsidian Blade (2 Mana, Hold) comes to your hand on your first turn. Every Sharpen makes it hit harder for the rest of the fight, and some Auras make it strike every enemy or strike twice.
Court cards create cards: Retainers (free Attacks and guards), Neutral cards, Rubble. Created cards feed the Auras that count them.
